images.prompt: Edit the reference image. Keep the SAME young woman: the same face, the same dark skin tone, the same body proportions and height, the same photoreal 3D character render style, the same soft studio lighting, and a plain white background. Change ONLY these things. POSE: a symmetric A-pose, front view, facing the camera. The arms are straight and point down and out at about 45 degrees from the body, with a clear gap between each arm and the torso at the armpits. The legs are straight and apart, feet at shoulder width, with a clear gap between the thighs. HANDS: open and flat, palms toward the thighs, all five fingers spread apart with visible gaps between the fingers, the thumb apart from the hand. HEAD: completely bald, a smooth bare scalp with no hair, no braids, no bun; no eyebrows; no earrings, no jewelry. Neutral face, mouth closed, eyes open, looking at the camera. CLOTHES: remove the jacket, the crop top, the joggers, the knee pads, the wristband and the roller skates. She wears only a plain matte light-gray form-fitting sports crop top and plain fitted light-gray bike shorts that end at mid-thigh. Bare feet, flat on the floor, toes visible. The full body from the top of the head to the toes is in the frame, centered, with a small margin.
images.use: The conform source: bare body, A-pose, open hands, no hair.

images.prompt: Edit the reference image only. Keep the SAME woman, the SAME A-pose, the SAME camera, the SAME frame, and the SAME size and place of the body in the frame. Do NOT move the arms, the legs, the hands or the head. The hands stay open with the fingers apart. The head stays bald with a smooth scalp and no hair. Dress her in this outfit, worn over the body: a cropped light peach-orange bomber jacket, open at the front, with long full sleeves that end in ribbed cuffs at the wrists, the jacket hem at the bottom of the ribs; under the jacket a plain cream crop top; loose dark-green jogger sweatpants with a drawstring waist, elastic cuffs at the lower calf; cream knee pads with small gold studs over the joggers at the knees; a dark-green sweat wristband on her right wrist (the left side of the image); cream leather lace-up quad roller skates with gold wheels and peach toe stops. The skates are on her feet at the same place in the frame, the wheels on the floor. Same photoreal 3D character render style, same soft studio lighting, plain white background, full body in the frame.
